name: Education channels: deterministic upload readiness, one repository per channel, syndication into Turntide Islands
asks: "We should enrich our software such that that whole process is more automated, such that something deterministic checks every so often if the video is ready for upload." (2026-09-24); "no these are supposed to be each channel its own repo" (2026-09-30); "Approved; we also wanna fix the 'syndicate Causeway Youtube Channels into TTI channels'" (2026-10-03)

x-provenance.recorded-by: claude (Red Cup Engineer Senior, pass education-media)
x-provenance.basis: EARS rendering of three utterances. R5 is the behaviour whose absence the code shows (a throw when no channel declares subjects); the specific defect the Leader meant is the open question of the specification note.

board-opening.need: Education videos reach YouTube and Turntide Islands without an agent session deciding each step, from channels that are each their own repository.

requirements.says: The education production service shall decide a video's readiness for upload from the episode's retained receipts and shall name the reason for each video it holds back.
requirements.rationale: 2026-09-24: "something deterministic checks ... if the video is ready for upload".

requirements.says: The education production service shall make the readiness decision on a recurring clock.
The education programme shall hold each channel in its own repository.
The syndication job shall offer each newly public video of every education channel that declares Turntide subjects to the Turntide Islands placement desk.
requirements.rationale: 2026-10-03: "syndicate Causeway Youtube Channels into TTI channels".

requirements.says: The syndication job shall report a channel that declares no Turntide subjects, and a channel it cannot observe, as typed results and shall continue with the other channels.
requirements.rationale: 2026-10-03: "we also wanna fix"; the script today throws when no channel declares subjects, which stops every channel.
